title: Senate Under Hollow Witness: First Pressure
description: Senate Under Hollow Witness unfolds across Laurel Senate dais with collapsing sky terraces and public vow markers, pushing a 5-Titan Olympian Titan to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Senate Under Hollow Witness: First Pressure advances Laurel Senate Trials: Olympus turns the reopened Gate into public trial law, forcing glory to become defense instead of vanity. It directly tests the faction tension: Glory unites them in public and divides them in private; every victory creates a jealous shadow.
